summary: AC1 — api-surface.md: Already complete from prior pipelines. All new TypeScript exports (registerConfigRoutes, git-credentials.ts functions, AppConfig.gitCredentials) and the GUI Client api.config.credentials namespace were already documented.
AC2 — rest-api.md: Already complete. Full /api/config/credentials section (GET/PUT/DELETE) with validation rules and response body shapes was already present.
AC3 — gui-frontend.md: Already complete. Developer updated the Routes table (#/settings → settings.js) and the API Client section (api.config.credentials) during WP-009 implementation.

AC4 — constraints.md: Added the token masking rule as a new bullet in the Git Subprocess Security section. Documents that buildMaskedCredentials() must be applied before every credential API response, the maskToken() format (****+last-4-chars), and that this is a non-optional security control for any future credential endpoint.
Ran ctx generate — all 19 CTX documents regenerated cleanly.
